capabilities.justification: TcpServer::start binds a std::net::TcpListener (non-blocking) on the configured host and port.
Accepted TcpStream connections are read from and written to.
TcpListener::bind resolves the configured host name through ToSocketAddrs.
Source imports the std::thread module only to call thread::sleep; no threads are spawned. Declared because the lexical analyzer classifies the bare module import as thread:spawn.
The serve loop sleeps 10 ms via thread::sleep when no connection had work.

justification: Single-threaded polling TCP server: binds a listener on a configured host and port, accepts connections and exchanges bytes with a pluggable handler. No filesystem, process, or environment access.
